articles.title: Sony Announces New PS Plus 'Perks' for YouTube and Other Services, but Fans Say They're 'Not Real Perks'
articles.summary: Sony has announced a range of new “perks” for PS Plus, including a three-month trial to YouTube Premium, as well as trials and discounts for other services. But not all fans are on board.
articles.body:
Sony has announced a range of new “perks” for PS Plus, including a three-month trial to YouTube Premium, as well as trials and discounts for other services. But not all fans are on board.

"Enjoy a range of special offers, trials and discounts from PlayStation, Sony and select partners. All included with your PlayStation Plus membership," Sony's announcement reads.

Those partners include YouTube Premium, DAZN, Audible, and Sony Pictures' own Core. Elsewhere, PS Plus members get a 5% discount when they buy direct from PlayStation, they can save 10% on gaming and audio from Sony Electronics, and a two month trial of Calm Premium.

The 100 Best PlayStation Games of All Time

"How is a free trial a perk?" one person complained on social media . "Calling free trials a perk is a big reach," another person commented. "These are not real perks, these are just money for Sony by funnelling people into these other subscriptions," another said. "Nobody cares about a free trial. Give us full crunchy roll premium on ps plus and then maybe we will be happy," one person suggested.

Others are using the perks announcement to once again criticize Sony for its decision to kill PlayStation discs from 2028. “Are Physical discs a perk?” said one social media user . “This reeks of desperation,” said another before continuing: “So many people have abandoned PS Plus as a result of Sony’s plans to end physical discs, that they are now trying to entice people with the old carrot and the stick routine.”

The disc backlash does not appear to have affected Sony's bottom line so far. In Sony’s recent financial results , the number of monthly active users (MAUs) across the PlayStation platform actually increased 7% in September compared to the same month of the previous fiscal year to 127 million accounts — that’s a record high for September. Sony said this indicates “the baseline of engagement is steadily improving.”

According to the same results, 78% of game sales over the period were digital, which is a significant majority. With digital sales of first-party games, Sony gets the full cut of revenue.

articles.title: Hellboy Attends Satan's Funeral in Hellboy in Hell: Parade of Horrors
articles.summary: What happens when Hellboy crashes Satan's funeral? Find out in this exclusive preview of Hellboy in Hell: Parade of Horrors.
articles.body:
While Mike Mignola may have capped off his Hellboy saga several years ago , there are always more stories worth telling in this horror universe. Case in point: Mignola and artist Márk László are revisiting the series Hellboy in Hell to tell a new story about the hero's time in the underworld. What happens when Hellboy crashes Satan's funeral?

To find out, check out IGN's exclusive preview of Hellboy in Hell: Parade of Horrors #1 in the slideshow gallery below:

Hellboy in Hell: Parade of Horrors #1 Preview Gallery

Hellboy in Hell: Parade of Horrors is written by Mignola and illustrated by László, with colors by Dave Stewart and letters by Clem Robins. The first issue features cover art by László and Mignola. Here's the official summary for the new series:

Following the events of Hellboy in Hell: Nothing But Blood, Hellboy sets off in search of a drink, but finds himself in a cemetery just in time to witness a macabre procession in honor of Satan’s death. Not all of the demons are happy to see him after their Lord’s murder. This morbid celebration in the pits of Pandemonium will introduce readers to a horrific host of new characters haunting the hallowed halls of Hell and send Hellboy on an all-new adventure in surreal depths of Mike Mignola’s singular version of Hell.

“I hadn’t planned to return to Hellboy’s HELL — I certainly didn’t think I’d ever let anyone else in there. But I love Márk’s work, and when we met he said he wanted to do a story set there. Well, how could I say no?” said Mignola in a statement. “Fortunately, there were a couple big holes between the chapters I’d drawn and I thought Márk would have fun with those two dead soldiers we meet in 'The Three Gold Whips' — and he did! I only gave him a rough outline for a story, and he took it from there. And as things took shape, we found a place to introduce a bit more of the history of the place. Every time I think we are done with this thing it seems we find there are just a few more bits and pieces to explore, which I guess is a good thing.”

articles.title: Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble Shutting Down Less Than a Year After Launch
articles.summary: It was announced less than a year ago, but Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble — a mobile spin-off of the flagship PlayStation series — has been canceled.
articles.body:
It was announced less than a year ago, but Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble — a mobile spin-off of the flagship PlayStation series — has been canceled. Today marks the final update to the game, and it will shut down entirely in May 2027. The game was technically still in a soft launch phase, ahead of a full global release.

"We’ve made the difficult decision to cease development of Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble. The final planned update will be rolling out November 6th, 2026, and the app will be removed from stores on November 21st, 2026. Players who already have the game will be able to continue playing until May 1st, 2027, when the game’s servers will permanently shut down. On behalf of the dev team and everyone helping to make the game, thanks to our amazing community for all your support, especially to those who have spent time playing, sharing feedback, and helping shape Ranger Rumble throughout its development!"

According to the official announcement, in-app purchases have been removed from the game, with the announcement advising players to use any in-game rewards or currency before the game shuts down. In an FAQ, players seeking some sort of refund for money spent are directed to Apple’s App Store or Google Play customer support.

The game offered arena shooter-style action with characters from the series and was developed by Oh BiBi in collaboration with Insonmiac Games and PlayStation Studios. As recently as July, the PlayStation blog shared that the game was "gearing up for global launch" after "a successful testing phase shaped by player feedback."

articles.title: Where to Get Shiny Ore - Crimson Desert Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Shiny Ore is a new mineral added in the Crimson Desert DLC, Charting the Unknown. You'll need it to build certain ships and to craft many ocean-related
articles.body:
Shiny Ore is a new mineral added in the Crimson Desert DLC, Charting the Unknown . You'll need it to build certain ships and to craft many ocean-related blueprints. Unlike other minerals, you won't find it along mountains or on land altogether. You'll need to either dive underwater to find Shiny Ore deposits or search for Drifting Boxes.

Due to its name, you can expect this ore to be shiny and even glow a little. Fortunately, many islands across the South Sea have Shiny Ore deposits underwater. Continue reading for advice on where to look if you need somewhere to start!

A reliable method of getting Shiny Ore without diving underwater is to loot Drifting Boxes . You can find these boxes floating in the ocean regardless of where you are. If you don't want to wait for them to appear, you can also destroy other ships to spawn a couple of them.

In our experience, these boxes usually have anywhere from 5 to 13 Shiny Ore. The nice part about farming Drifting Boxes is that they contain other useful materials too. Such as blueprints and Malachite , which you'll need for certain recipes too.

Aside from gathering Drifting Boxes, you can also mine Shiny Ore deposits underwater. This can be challenging early on if you don't have any diving equipment yet. Until you do, you'll have a limited amount of breath to work with. However, you can swim into air bubbles to regain oxygen. This is a good way to complete the challenge of staying underwater for five minutes.

One potential bug we've noticed is that Shiny Ore deposits won't appear on your map when discovered. Instead, they only appear on the minimap. Keep this in mind as you find them if you plan on revisiting those locations. We've included a few spots where you can find them around Auronui Island below, but you can check many islands in the South Sea for more.

One of the early DLC Faction Quests sends you to Auronui Island. While your crew is ecstatic about finding Azurite Ore there, you'll also find Shiny Ore here if you know where to look. Head to the Abyss Nexus fast travel point on Auronui Island and then dive off the northwest side. You'll immediately run into a few Shiny Ore veins.

Shiny Ore Near the Auronui Island Anchorage

A little west of the Anchorage/dock has a deposit you can mine. You won't find as much as the previous spot, but this is another relatively easy one to get to. Which works well even if you don't have diving equipment.

Shiny Ore Northeast of the Main Auronui Island

If you go northeast of the main Auronui Island toward the mini island nearby, you can head east from there next. This will lead to a few Shiny Ore deposits worth mining.

articles.title: Marvel Comics Is Relaunching Hulk in 2027, and the First Issue Is Free
articles.summary: Marvel Comics has tapped the creative team behind Ultimate Wolverine to relaunch the monthly Hulk series, and the first issue will be completely free.
articles.body:
Marvel Comics may be gearing up for the Hulk War: Infernal Rage crossover , but they're also looking ahead to what's next for the iconic hero. The publisher revealed that they'll be relaunching the monthly Hulk series in 2027, and the first issue will be completely free.

Marvel will release the new Hulk #1 in May 2027 as part of Comics Giveaway Day (the companion event to Free Comic Book Day). The standard edition will be completely free, but fans can also pay to pick up "True Believers Blind Bag" variant copies. Marvel will also be selling bundles that contain 19 blind bag comics and one exclusive glow-in-the-dark variant by artist Patrick Gleason.

The new Hulk series will be written by Chris Condon and illustrated by Alessandro Cappuccio. The duo previously collaborated on Ultimate Wolverine. Here's the official description of the new series:

HULK’S NEXT AGE BEGINS IN THE SHADOW OF INFERNAL HULK!

Bruce Banner is left with the curse he’s spent his life trying to escape…and he’s done running.

An impossible temptation promises a permanent cure, placing Banner’s salvation within reach, but bringing his final damnation one step closer.

LURKING IN THE SHADOWS, A NEW MONSTER RISES.

Banner’s desperate hunt for a cure will reveal how much he’ll sacrifice to bury the Hulk forever.

"Dreams do come true, it seems, even if it comes at the suffering of poor Bruce Banner,” Condon said in a statement. “I am beyond thrilled to be a part of the team chronicling the next era of the Jade Giant at Marvel, and to be reteamed with my pal Alessandro Cappuccio--as well as legendary Hulk editor Mark Paniccia--makes it all the more exciting. I've loved the Hulk since I was a kid and that love has continued to this very day, so I hope people know that what we're crafting is in tribute to everything from Lee & Kirby's initial debut to Phillip Kennedy Johnson, Nic Klein, & company's horrifyingly brilliant Infernal Hulk saga. We are taking things in an exciting new direction for our day and age, but don't worry, HULK STILL SMASH."

Hulk #1 will be released on May 1, 2027. You can find your local comic shop to see which stores are participating in Comics Giveaway Day/Free Comic Book Day.

articles.title: Dead by Daylight Jumps to Positive Ratings After Steam Hides 'Off-Topic' Reviews Following BurntPeanut Backlash
articles.summary: Dead by Daylight has returned to 'Mostly Positive' recent reviews on Steam after Valve labeled a chunk of ratings surrounding TheBurntPeanut backlash as 'off-topic.'
articles.body:
Dead by Daylight has returned to 'Mostly Positive' recent reviews on Steam after Valve labeled a chunk of ratings surrounding TheBurntPeanut backlash as 'off-topic.'

To catch you up to speed, developer Behaviour Interactive's recent work with controversial streamer TheBurntPeanut landed its asymmetrical horror game in the line of fire . A few apologetic posts and hundreds of comments later, Dead by Daylight spent much of this week showing declining favorability ratings on Steam (via SteamDB ) – but that now seems to be a thing of the past.

Check out its Steam page today, and you'll find that Dead by Daylight now boasts 'Mostly Positive' reviews, with a little asterisk clarifying the reasoning for this sudden jump. A disclaimer shared in the reviews section of its page notes that the dates between November 1 – 6 have been noted for off-topic activity. Valve explained that the range has been "marked as containing an abnormal set of reviews that we believe are largely unrelated to the likelihood that you would enjoy the product." As a result, "the reviews within this period are excluded from the Review Score by default."

Dead by Daylight 10th Anniversary Broadcast Visual Overhaul Reveal - Screenshots

Steam users have the freedom to unmark the reviews Steam has deemed to be off-topic. Doing so reflects a 'Mixed' score instead, with the Mostly Positive rating shown by default. After a week of back-and-forth between Behaviour and its community, fans generally have been unhappy with Dead by Daylight, even if the reaction comes from behavior outside of the game itself. Although reviews may seem to be back on track, fans across social media still want to make their voices heard.

"They can't reverse the damage to their reputation or s***ty customer service," one player said .

"In this case, Valve is wrong," another argued . "The negative reviews were completely justified."

Meanwhile, there has been some confusion from the Dead by Daylight community regarding what Valve's process is for labeling reviews as off-topic. It's something the company directly addressed in a 2019 blog post , with it, at the time, saying its goal was to remove anomalous activity that could inaccurately reflect a game's rating based on factors the average player doesn't care about.

It's Valve's attempt to combat review-bombing campaigns that it's incorporated for years, with it saying that it had developed a tool "that identifies any anomalous review activity on all games on Steam in as close to real-time as possible." Its description continued: "It doesn't know why a given game is receiving anomalous review activity, and it doesn't even try to figure that out. Instead, it notifies a team of people at Valve, who'll then go and investigate."

If investigators believe activity within a certain period fits the definition of off-topic, Valve will "mark the time period it encompasses and notify the developer." How the Steam company's process for identifying and neutralizing inauthentic reviews may have changed in the last seven and a half years is unclear.

When reached for clarification, Behaviour told IGN it "is not at liberty to discuss any platform partner (review) processes" and pointed to its most recent statement related to this week's controversy. IGN has also reached out to Valve for comment and clarification.

As Dead by Daylight returns to general positivity on Steam, the period of controversy does seem to have come to an end. Behaviour's most recent public comment on the matter saw it clarify that it had removed gifted content from TheBurntPeanut's account, while promising that it would be "taking appropriate action" regarding how the incident happened in the first place.

Dead By Daylight's New Urban Map for All-Kill: Comeback

Last month, the studio announced Child's Play Killer Chucky would be the latest icon removed from sale . It told IGN in a statement that Killers will "continue to have an open invitation to join (or rejoin)."

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

Dusk, the Puppeteer, is an optional boss.

The Puppeteer's Bell can be upgraded to unlock new abilities and other powers. Below you'll find a table that lays out everything you'll find when leveling up this Phantom Edge.

ENDIX, the fully digital, free-to-attend gaming expo, is now live from today, November 6, through November 8, and it offers guests from around the world the opportunity to step onto a virtual show floor to check out over 50 games, play demos, watch world premieres and exclusive trailers, and even speak to the studios and publishers behind the titles through integrated voice chat, all from the comfort of their own homes.

By downloading ENDIX for free on Steam or the Epic Games Store, guests can create their own avatar and walk through the show floor, stopping at virtual themed halls, rooftop spaces, and dedicated publisher areas, including THQ Nordic Island, where players can check out Titan Quest II, Expeditions: Samurai, Fatekeeper, and The Eternal Life of Goldman.

Furthermore, guests can head over to the City Mega Stand to see Crema's Temtem: Pioneers, walk over to the laid-back Cozy Area, or test their mettle within the eerie halls of the horror-themed Theatrum Obscurum.

We can’t wait to open the virtual doors in November.”

articles.title: The Lenovo Legion Tower 5i Has the Power for Gaming, Streaming, and Editing
articles.body:
Sometimes gaming doesn't just mean playing a game. It also means livestreaming and interacting with your audience. It can also mean recording, editing, and posting stream footage. Some gamers are keeping up with performance demand by returning to a dedicated desktop setup that can be upgraded easily and safely. The Lenovo Legion Tower 5i is an ideal PC for your next-level gaming experience.

A good desktop is a solid partner in life

A desktop computer isn’t just a smart short-term purchase; it’s a good investment. Desktops are reliable “work horses” that can perform steadily even when they’re put under processing stress. If building a PC from scratch seems intimidating, pre-built towers take the mystery out of assembling one. You’re set from the start for work, life, and gaming, and there’s still plenty of room for upgrade options.

A reliable desktop can be in your life for years. Everything you do with the Lenovo Legion Tower 5i is powered by the Intel Core Ultra 7 series, a powerhouse that works alongside the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 to make sure your media and apps run smoothly.

A reliable PC build can't focus on graphical fidelity alone. It needs to maintain steady framerates during long streams, especially while playing in competitive genres like fighting or action games. Overheated processors drop frames, which means a drop in audience numbers. The Lenovo Legion Tower 5i keeps everything smooth and frosty with its Legion ColdFront cooling architecture.

And this chilly tech helps keep the Lenovo Legion Tower 5i going after the game is done. Its state-of-the-art Intel Core Ultra 7 265F processing power and its lightning-quick 2TB SSD storage cut way down on the time it takes to edit, render, and post video footage of your latest session. That leaves you with more time to dive into more games.

The Lenovo Legion Tower 5i also has style to spare thanks to its see-through side panel that's perfect for admiring your customizable RGB lighting. Wind down at the end of a hard day in the neon glow of your own light show. Ready for a change? The Lenovo Legion Tower 5i's chassis is upgrade-friendly, even for beginners.

If you're a heavy duty gamer with lengthy game sessions followed by lots of video editing work, you might get a lot more done a lot more quickly with the power and versatility of a PC like the Lenovo Legion Tower 5i. It’s what you need to work, play, produce, and communicate with friends without performance compromise.

articles.title: Blizzard Reveals What Made It Finally Pull The Trigger on WoW Forever
articles.summary: World of Warcraft Forever came out earlier this week, and has been a massively successful launch. It almost begs the question, "Why wait this long?" Well, Blizzard has revealed what made it finally release the Classic+ game mode.
articles.body:
World of Warcraft Forever came out earlier this week, and has been a massively successful launch. It almost begs the question, "Why wait this long?" Well, Blizzard has revealed what made it finally release the Classic+ game mode.

In an interview with Bloomberg , Blizzard senior game designer Josh Greenfield revealed that the developer had been kicking around the idea of WoW Forever since before Classic released in 2019, but the team ultimately pulled the trigger on the straight-up port of Vanilla WoW first. But while Forever was put on the backburner, the Classic team started to get a little bit more experimental as the old-school version of the MMO aged.

Then, in 2023, Blizzard released a new game mode, Season of Discovery, which took Classic and made some pretty radical changes, like ability gems and turning old 5-player dungeons like Blackfathom Deeps into full-scale raids. This game mode had some pretty immediate impacts on even retail WoW, like when Blizzard released Mists of Pandaria Remix in 2024 and Legion Remix in 2025.

But it turns out that the biggest impact that Season of Discovery had was making the WoW team pull the trigger on Classic+, or Forever. According to Greenfield, the community response to Season of Discovery is what made Forever actually happen. He told Bloomberg, “That’s really when the conversation started around, ‘Hey, what does a permanent version of this game look like?’”

Season of Discovery's success also helped convince leadership to allow development on Forever to proceed, and once the team started getting the new graphics engines in place, everything seems to come together. According to that Bloomberg piece, Northshire Abbey became a tech demo of sorts, and one that won over pretty much everyone at Blizzard.

And it's good that it did. IGN's early review of World of Warcraft Forever is extremely positive, and while it'll obviously be a while before the full review is finished, reviewer Len Hafer says, "[Blizzard] made me believe I can go home again – and that home is somewhere I want to spend more time, with new surprises to discover. Let's see if they can keep it up for 47 more levels. Watch this space for updates in the weeks to come."

Players seem impressed with WoW Forever as well, especially on the back of an extremely smooth launch that was almost completely free of any kind of server problems . It doesn't hurt that Blizzard dedicated a ton of hardware to keeping the servers running smoothly at launch, with around 200TB of memory .
